units.source_text: 他和她一起在大床上交谈，卧室窗外飘着雨。

en.t: He talked with her on the large bed, while rain drifted outside the bedroom window.

units.source_text: 在这场雨里，木棉花没准什么时候就会烂掉吧。

en.t: In this rain, the kapok flowers might rot away at any moment.
Her face still seemed as if it were under the moonlight.

units.source_text: 但是和她聊天，他不免感到兴趣索然。

en.t: But as he talked with her, he could not help feeling bored.

units.source_text: 他趴着，默默地点起一支纸烟，想起他们一起生活已已经有七年了。

en.t: Lying on his stomach, he silently lit a cigarette and thought that they had already been living together for seven years.
